sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • SECURITY: Added sanitization callback for register_setting() to validate and sanitize all plugin options
  • SECURITY: Added re-sanitization of data points when loaded from database to prevent XSS attacks
  • SECURITY: Enhanced input sanitization for all data point fields (content, URLs, text fields, numeric values)
  • SECURITY: Added capability check (manage_options) to settings page function
  • SECURITY: Added proper escaping throughout the plugin (esc_url, esc_attr, esc_html, esc_js, wp_json_encode)
  • CODE: Fixed WordPress Coding Standards violations (function spacing, hook names, input sanitization)
  • CODE: Improved code quality and compliance with WordPress Plugin Check requirements
  • CODE: Added proper escaping and sanitization throughout the plugin
  • CODE: Updated plugin header with License field and corrected plugin name
  • CODE: Updated “Tested up to” version to 6.9
